result_text:
`all_files.zip` now packages the scope file lists under names derived from the configured aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer breaks the export. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config, so the `buildAndDeployment` case is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/`. The hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The code now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName`, which is the same call the loose text files use. It then reads that file and adds it to the zip.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written again too, because the failed read no longer aborts the export before that step.
